actions.name: deployed DarkSide ransomware
actions.description: In May 2021, leading into Mother’s Day weekend, malicious cyber actors deployed DarkSide ransomware against the IT network of a U.S.-based critical infrastructure entity in the Energy Sector, resulting in a week-long suspension of operations.

actions.name: exfiltrated data before threatening to publish it
actions.description: After DarkSide actors gained access to the victim’s network, they deployed ransomware to encrypt victim data and—as a secondary form of extortion—exfiltrated the data before threatening to publish it to further pressure victims into paying the ransom demand.

actions.name: conducted Sodinokibi/REvil ransomware attack
actions.description: In May 2021, over the Memorial Day weekend, a critical infrastructure entity in the Food and Agricultural Sector suffered a Sodinokibi/REvil ransomware attack affecting U.S. and Australian meat production facilities, resulting in a complete production stoppage.

actions.name: attacked with Sodinokibi/REvil ransomware
actions.description: In July 2021, during the Fourth of July holiday weekend, Sodinokibi/REvil ransomware actors attacked a U.S.-based critical infrastructure entity in the IT Sector and implementations of their remote monitoring and management tool, affecting hundreds of organizations—including multiple managed service providers and their customers.

actions.name: use phishing and brute forcing unsecured RDP endpoints for initial access
actions.description: The two most prevalent initial access vectors are phishing and brute forcing unsecured remote desktop protocol (RDP) endpoints.
actions.epistemic_reason: 原文描述的是工具／惡意程式具備的能力，沒有說這個動作在本事件中實際發生。
